2608.05783.title: GROM: Gradient-Free Rapid One-Shot Machine Unlearning
2608.05783.paper_summary: Machine unlearning has become a critical capability for safely removing specific, sensitive knowledge from large language models (LLMs). Current state-of-the-art approaches primarily rely on iterative, training-time unlearning via fine-tuning. However, even when utilizing parameter-efficient dimensionality reduction techniques like LoRA, gradient-based optimization remains computationally expensive and lacks explicit analytical formulations. It can also leave the targeted knowledge merely hidden rather than removed, to the point that simply quantizing the unlearned model restores much of what it was supposed to have erased. To resolve this, we propose a novel one-shot unlearning approach, abandoning iterative optimization in favor of a direct, exact analytical solution. We frame the unlearning process as a ridge-regularized least-squares optimization problem, deriving a closed-form additive update for targeted weight matrices. This update forces the selected layer to suppress unwanted content while strictly preserving its behavior on retained data. Computed from gradient-free forward passes alone, with no backpropagation and no iteration to convergence, GROM applies the weight edit in mere seconds, which makes it orders of magnitude faster than traditional fine-tuning. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that GROM achieves state-of-the-art forgetting-utility trade-offs on TOFU-5%, TOFU-10%, MUSE-Books, MUSE-News and WMDP, significantly reducing computational overhead without sacrificing overall model performance. Because the update removes the targeted content from the weights instead of masking it, GROM also withstands the low-bit quantization attack that recovers much of the content a gradient-based baseline had appeared to forget. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/GROM.
2608.05783.paper_summary_zh: 機器遺忘已成為安全地從大型語言模型（LLMs）中移除特定敏感知識的重要能力。當前的最先進方法主要依賴於通過微調進行的迭代訓練時間遺忘。然而，即使使用像 LoRA 這樣的參數高效降維技術，基於梯度的優化仍然計算成本高昂，且缺乏明確的分析公式。它還可能僅僅將目標知識隱藏，而不是移除，以至於簡單地量化未學習的模型會恢復它應該已經抹去的許多內容。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一種新穎的一次性遺忘方法，放棄了迭代優化，轉而採用直接的精確分析解。我們將遺忘過程框定為一個帶有脊正則化的最小二乘優化問題，推導出針對性權重矩陣的閉合形式加法更新。這一更新迫使所選層抑制不需要的內容，同時嚴格保留其在保留數據上的行為。僅從無梯度的前向傳遞計算，無需反向傳播和迭代收斂，GROM 在幾秒鐘內應用權重編輯，這使其比傳統微調快幾個數量級。大量評估表明，GROM 在 TOFU-5%、TOFU-10%、MUSE-Books、MUSE-News 和 WMDP 上實現了最先進的遺忘-效用權衡，顯著降低了計算開銷而不犧牲整體模型性能。由於該更新從權重中移除了目標內容，而不是將其遮蔽，因此 GROM 也能抵抗低位量化攻擊，該攻擊恢復了基於梯度的基線似乎已經遺忘的許多內容。我們的代碼已公開可用，網址為 https://github.com/Batorskq/GROM。
